## What changed and why

## How it was checked

- [ ] Tests pass (`python -m unittest discover -s tests`) and new behaviour has a test
- [ ] No tokens, session files, serial numbers or other personal data in the change, the tests or the screenshots
- [ ] If it touches unlocking, login or the log: it follows the safety rules in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] User-facing changes are in `CHANGELOG.md` and the docs
